sar.narrative: Customer C07297, holder of card C07297-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online activity totaling $1,906.07. Between 2016-11-21 20:00 and 2016-11-21 20:30, four online purchases were executed minutes apart using device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080'. The specific transactions include $478.95 on 2016-11-21 20:00 (reference 3476602), $456.96 on 2016-11-21 20:10 (reference 3476633), $488.04 on 2016-11-21 20:24 (reference 3476665), and $482.12 on 2016-11-21 20:30 (reference 3476682). Every amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold, and the $482.12 transaction significantly exceeded the card's median of $60.73 and its 95th percentile of $319.86. Additionally, product code C was never used on this card before. The cardholder disputed the activity, stating, "I never made this $482.12 purchase. Please check my card." Refers to 3476682. This activity strongly resembles confirmed fraud cases CC-0031, CC-2079, CC-3235, and CC-3423, where 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases were confirmed fraud. In response to the suspicious activity, the bank has executed a case creation and analyst escalation, and has recommended blocking card C07297-K1 and filing this report.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.98 is at or above 0.85 with 3 independent pieces of evidence, so the decision is defensible without asking the customer (policy 6).
